spec_match.rationale: The three gates are the feature's real preconditions: the js-profiling document policy (probed by constructing a real Profiler), the [CrossOriginIsolated] gate from the markers proposal, and the engine's marker implementation (probed from a genuine captured trace).

interactive.rationale: One button drives all three real probes including a 150ms real profiling session under induced load.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises three live gates; delivered with per-gate explanations.

edge_cases.rationale: Each gate reports its distinct blocked/warn/ok state; gate 3 distinguishes a real-but-unmarked trace from a blocked construction.

references.rationale: Feature index cites https://chromestatus.com/feature/5201297767792640 plus the markers explainer, spec PR, base spec, and the sibling v147 worker-profiling demo.

conformance.rationale: Suite asserts construction-under-policy, trace shape, marker vocabulary when present, the COI gate, and keeps the isolated-Chrome-153 run as a manual assertion.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP run on the route now serving Document-Policy: js-profiling — gate 1 genuinely succeeded, gate 2 read crossOriginIsolated false, gate 3 captured a real 15-sample trace with zero marker members; zero console errors; 0px overflow both classes; screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: jsm-gates-ran asserts with sample and marked counts.

design_system.rationale: Gate results in emerald/amber/rose on stone (AA); CSS variables only.

accessibility.rationale: Each gate result is its own aria-live region; native button; headings number the gates.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Single-column gate cards; 0px overflow at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×2000.

openQuestions.title: Open gate 2 with COOP/COEP on a dedicated route
openQuestions.detail: The origin doesn't send Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy/Embedder-Policy, so crossOriginIsolated is false and markers can never appear even on Chrome 153. A follow-up server route (like the existing document-policy special case) could serve COOP+COEP for these demo paths — needs care since COEP require-corp affects the shared stylesheet/telemetry fetches.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Give each check its own announced result region.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Each gate's result line is role=status aria-live.

guidanceConsulted.query: stacked gate cards wrapping results mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Wrap long result strings inside bordered cards.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Results use overflow-wrap:anywhere; verified 0px overflow at 360px.

summary: Verified headlessly (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): with the new Document-Policy route support wired in routes/release.ts, gate 1 genuinely passes on this origin, and gates 2–3 report their honest closed states on Chromium 141. The COOP/COEP follow-up is recorded as the open question.
